caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a bag or pouch with a drawstring and a decorative pattern. The bag is primarily rendered in shades of blue and brown. The top of the bag features a solid dark band with a blue ribbon threaded through it, forming a drawstring that extends out on both sides with the right end tied in a loose knot. The main body of the bag has a lattice or diamond pattern in light blue on a darker blue or black background, with a horizontal decorative band of floral or abstract motifs near the top and again near the bottom. The bag’s bottom edge is finished with a fringe made up of blue threads, hanging in a neat row. The background of the drawing is plain and beige, with no additional objects or scenery depicted. There is a small red mark near the bottom right corner, and a small signature or artist's mark near the lower right edge of the bag.
title: Beaded Bag
